From c14556fc0c7c115ffb4a287560e1ec9f7869aac3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Mika Westerberg <mika.westerberg@linux.intel.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2020 12:39:11 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] thunderbolt: Drop duplicated 0x prefix from format string

The tb_dbg() call is using %#x that already adds the 0x prefix so don't
duplicate it.

Fixes: 9039387e166e ("thunderbolt: Add USB4 router operation proxy for firmware connection manager")
Signed-off-by: Mika Westerberg <mika.westerberg@linux.intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Yehezkel Bernat <YehezkelShB@gmail.com>

diff --git a/drivers/thunderbolt/icm.c b/drivers/thunderbolt/icm.c
index 8b7f941a9bb7..b8c4159bc32d 100644
--- a/drivers/thunderbolt/icm.c
+++ b/drivers/thunderbolt/icm.c
@@ -2316,7 +2316,7 @@ static int icm_usb4_switch_nvm_authenticate_status(struct tb_switch *sw,
 
 	if (auth && auth->reply.route_hi == sw->config.route_hi &&
 	    auth->reply.route_lo == sw->config.route_lo) {
-		tb_dbg(tb, "NVM_AUTH found for %llx flags 0x%#x status %#x\n",
+		tb_dbg(tb, "NVM_AUTH found for %llx flags %#x status %#x\n",
 		       tb_route(sw), auth->reply.hdr.flags, auth->reply.status);
 		if (auth->reply.hdr.flags & ICM_FLAGS_ERROR)
 			ret = -EIO;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/thunderbolt/icm.c`**
   - The format string in the `tb_dbg()` function call was modified. The original string included a duplicated `0x` prefix for the `flags` parameter:
     - Original: `"NVM_AUTH found for %llx flags 0x%#x status %#x\n"`
     - Modified: `"NVM_AUTH found for %llx flags %#x status %#x\n"`
   - This change removes the redundant `0x` prefix since the `%#x` format specifier already includes it.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in the `drivers/thunderbolt/icm.c` file is aimed at improving the clarity and correctness of the debug output by eliminating redundancy. The change ensures that the output format is consistent and avoids confusion that may arise from having multiple `0x` prefixes for the same value. This patch is a direct response to a bug identified in a previous commit (9039387e166e), which introduced the issue of the duplicated prefix.
